from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted key facts from a single judgment document for matching purposes."""
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document, e.g., '民事二审判决书', '行政诉讼再审裁定书'")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The specific case identifier, e.g., '(2023) 沪 02 执异 168 号'")
    primary_party: str | None = Field(description="The main party's name relevant to the appeal/application, e.g., '佘某', '广州博某地产开发有限公司'")
    opposing_party: str | None = Field(description="The opposing party's name if relevant, e.g., '某先进材料有限公司'")
    ruling_summary: str | None = Field(description="The core ruling outcome in short, e.g., '驳回复议申请，维持原裁定', '撤销原判，驳回诉讼请求'")
    fee_details: str | None = Field(description="Mentioned fee amounts or cost burden allocation if any, e.g., '二审案件受理费 1677.82 元'")
    is_final_ruling: str | None = Field(description="Explicit finality statement if present, e.g., '终审裁定', '终审判决'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A verbatim excerpt capturing the ruling decision")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentRecord]
